ios.desc:
Create professional headshots, no physical photo shoots required! 

LevelUp provides fast and high quality headshots you'd have to pay hundreds or thousands of dollars for at a physical studio!

The process is simple. Just upload 10-30 selfies of yourself, making sure you follow the guidelines for best quality, and after 30 minutes we'll deliver at least 48 professional pictures straight to your phone. You can choose which photos to download, and upload them to your professional profiles.

We provide the best headshots in the world for the prices we charge. If you're not happy with your results, reach out to our support team and we'll make it right! Guaranteed.

FAQ:


Q: Who owns my AI headshots?

A: You have 100% ownership over your photos.


Q: I didn't like any of my photos, what can I do?

A: Please reach out to our support staff at Cuff Media Group and we'll work with you until you find photos you're happy with.


Q: How do I get the best quality photos?

A: Follow our guidelines! Don't just take 20 selfies with the same clothes and background. Switch it up as much as you can! 


Q: Why do I have to pay to use the app? Is there no free trial?


A: We have to use expensive computers to generate your AI in a short period of time (usually under 30 minutes!) This means we have costs high enough where we can't offer credits for free. If you have a strong reason why you believe you need our service but can't afford it, please reach out to support at: ali@cuff.live and we can work to help you.


Q: What face data does your app collect? 

A: LevelUp collects images of your face, including details of your eyes, nose, hair, mouth, skin, and other facial features necessary to train an AI model.


Q: How do we use the collected face data? 

A: With this AI model, we create professional headshot photos that resemble your face and are hyper-realistic.


Q: Will the data be shared with any third parties? Where will this information be stored? 

A: Your facial data is not shared with any third parties and is securely stored on our servers using AWS and Google Cloud services for storage.


Q: How long will the face data be retained? A: Your facial data is discarded as soon as the AI model is finished with creating your headshot photos.
